title: Data
text:
The workbook hayvan_besleme_2024_07.xlsx contains July 2024 records of street animal feeding (hayvan besleme) associated with the Ankara Provincial Health Directorate animal-feeding reporting (Turkish: Ankara İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü, Sağlık Dairesi / ilçe sağlık operations — replace this sentence with the exact portal or announcement URL you used).
Why we chose it: It is real, public operational data, Turkey-relevant, large enough for EDA (367 rows), and it connects to urban policy and animal welfare logistics.
Objectives (data-focused): Publish a fully reproducible import and cleaning pipeline; distribute a single cleaned object feeding as feeding_clean.RData.

title: Data
text:
Accomplishments (final deliverable — Data page)
The course asks you to discuss accomplishments on the Data page. Update this list before submission so it matches what you actually did:

Published a documented, reproducible path from the raw .xlsx to a single analysis-ready object feeding saved as feeding_clean.RData.
Standardized district and neighborhood labels (trimmed stray spaces) so counts by ilce are trustworthy.
Parsed text-encoded dry-food amounts into numeric mama_kg, and normalized vehicle / personnel fields (including Y3 → 3 and - → missing).
Did not drop rows for missing vehicle/personnel; all 367 raw rows remain in feeding so graders can reconcile with the spreadsheet. (If you later choose to exclude rows for a robustness check, describe that in a separate subsection and justify it.)

title: Data
text:
Import and preparation
Raw file location in this repository: data/raw/hayvan_besleme_2024_07.xlsx (copy from your Downloads if missing).
Steps (mirrors R/prepare_data.R):

Read the Excel sheet with fixed column types (date + text + numeric) so Turkish headers do not depend on janitor transliteration.
Rename columns to ASCII snake_case: tarih, ilce, mahalle_sokak, besleme_noktasi_sayisi, mama_text, arac_text, personel_text.
Trim extra spaces in ilce and mahalle_sokak (the raw file contains values like "GÖLBAŞI " with a trailing space).
Parse food mass: extract numeric kg from strings such as "84 KG" → mama_kg.
Parse vehicles: "-" → missing; "Y3" (typo) → 3; otherwise parse as number.
Parse personnel: "-" → missing; otherwise parse as number.
Save feeding to data/feeding_clean.RData.



Code

title: Analysis
text:
Topic: July 2024 street-animal feeding operations across Ankara ilçeler, from health-directorate-style operational records.
Data: 367 neighborhood-day records with feeding-point counts and kg/day dry food averages, plus vehicle and personnel fields.
Important aspects: District names needed trimming; food was text-encoded; vehicle column mixes numbers, "-", and a Y3 typo.
Interesting results: Çankaya, Keçiören, and Mamak dominate row counts; kg/day per record is right-skewed with a long tail of large feeding averages.
Main outcome: Clear district comparisons and temporal coverage (26 distinct calendar days in July) support a discussion of resource concentration and data quality for policy narratives.

title: Analysis
text:
Coverage in time and space


Code
feeding |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    first_day = min(tarih, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_day = max(tarih, na.rm = TRUE),
    distinct_days = n_distinct(as.Date(tarih)),
    distinct_ilce = n_distinct(ilce),
    missing_mama = sum(is.na(mama_kg)),
    missing_arac = sum(is.na(arac_sayisi)),
    missing_personel = sum(is.na(personel_sayisi))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Dataset coverage and missingness")

title: Analysis
text:
Conclusions (for your narrative)

Spatial concentration: A few districts account for most neighborhood-day rows — tie this to population, urban form, or program emphasis only as hypotheses unless you merge external data.
Skewed feeding amounts: A long right tail suggests a mix of small local drops and larger consolidated deliveries; outliers deserve qualitative mention.
Operational fields: Vehicle/personnel columns are sparse / low-variance; do not over-claim precision.

title: Street animal feeding in Greater Ankara (July 2024)
text:
Project summary
This project analyzes July 2024 street-animal feeding activity published by the Ankara Provincial Health Directorate (Ankara İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü). The spreadsheet records, by date and neighborhood, how many feeding points were active, the average daily dry food distributed (kg), and rolling vehicle and personnel counts used in feeding operations across Ankara districts.
Objectives: (1) describe spatial and temporal patterns; (2) compare districts in terms of feeding intensity; (3) highlight data-quality issues (e.g. coded missing values, typos) for transparent reporting.

title: Street animal feeding in Greater Ankara (July 2024)
text:
Key takeaways

Topic: Municipal street animal (“sokak hayvanı”) feeding logistics in Greater Ankara during July 2024, using official health-directorate-style operational records.
Data: 367 neighborhood-day rows with district, street/mahalle, feeding-point counts, average dry food (kg/day), and vehicle / personnel staffing indicators.
Important aspects: Food amounts were stored as text (e.g. "84 KG"); vehicle counts sometimes use "-" (missing) or a typo Y3 instead of 3 — we document and clean these in the Data page.
Interesting results: Districts differ strongly in how many rows (neighborhood-days) appear and in the distribution of kg/day per feeding point; some operational fields are almost constant across rows (see Analysis).
Main outcome: A reproducible Quarto site plus a cleaned .RData object for graders, suitable for your GitHub Pages presentation and HADI PDF submission.
